name: Time To Laugh
overview: Scripture reveals that laughter has a God-ordained place within the rhythms of life, as Ecclesiastes reminds us there is a time to weep and a time to laugh. Proverbs highlights the spiritual and physical benefit of a joyful heart, likening it to medicine that brings healing. Jesus also promises that those who now experience sorrow will one day laugh, underscoring the hope and restoration found in Christ amid life's trials.
